scheme_name: Financial Assistance for funeral and other activities in case of death of a worker's - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance for Funeral and Other Activities in Case of Death of a Worker’s Scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was officially launched on April 1, 2018.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the families of registered workers in Haryana who have passed away.

The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on the deceased worker's family during a time of grief and loss.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is set at ₹10,000.

This amount is intended to cover funeral expenses and other associated costs that arise upon the death of a worker.

The scheme specifically targets workers who are registered under the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

To be eligible for this financial assistance, the worker must have been a registered member of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at the time of their death.

The eligibility criteria also stipulate that the worker must have contributed to the welfare fund for a minimum period of six months prior to their death.

There are no specific age limits for the workers under this scheme.

However, the family members of the deceased worker must apply for the assistance within a stipulated time frame after the death.

The application process for this financial assistance is straightforward.

The family members of the deceased worker must submit an application to the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The application must include the death certificate of the worker.

Additionally, the application should include proof of the worker's registration with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

A copy of the worker's contribution receipt to the welfare fund must also be attached.

The application form can be obtained from the official website of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board or at their local offices.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the officials of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The processing time for the application is typically around 15 days.

Upon approval, the financial assistance amount of ₹10,000 will be disbursed to the bank account of the applicant.

The disbursement is made directly to ensure that the funds reach the intended beneficiaries without any delays.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana.

For any inquiries regarding the scheme, individuals can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at their official helpline number.

The helpline number is 1800 180 2087.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to enhance the welfare of workers in the state.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board has been active in implementing various welfare schemes since its establishment in 1969.

This specific scheme was introduced to address the immediate financial needs of families facing the loss of a breadwinner.

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to supporting the working class in Haryana.

In the fiscal year 2021-2022, the Haryana Labour Welfare Board allocated ₹5 crore for this scheme.

The board aims to assist approximately 50,000 families annually through this financial assistance program.

The scheme is particularly beneficial for workers in the unorganized sector who may not have access to other forms of financial support.

The financial assistance can be used for various expenses including funeral rites and other necessary arrangements.

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries who have found the support invaluable during difficult times.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board also conducts awareness programs to inform workers about the benefits available under this scheme.

These programs are held at various labor colonies and workplaces across the state.

The board collaborates with local NGOs and community organizations to reach out to the workers.

The assistance provided under this scheme is non-refundable and does not require any repayment.

This ensures that the families can utilize the funds without the burden of debt.

The scheme is part of the Haryana government's larger vision to improve the socio-economic conditions of laborers.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board also offers other welfare schemes aimed at health, education, and housing for workers.

The financial assistance for funeral expenses is a critical component of the support system for workers' families.

The scheme is designed to be inclusive and accessible to all registered workers in Haryana.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board regularly updates its policies to ensure that they meet the needs of the workforce.

The scheme has been instrumental in providing timely support to families in distress.

The government encourages all eligible workers to register with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board to avail of such benefits.

The scheme not only provides financial support but also serves as a recognition of the contributions made by workers to the state’s economy.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to monitor the implementation of this scheme to ensure its effectiveness.

The board is committed to transparency and accountability in the disbursement of funds.

The scheme is a testament to the Haryana government's dedication to worker welfare and social security.

In conclusion, the Financial Assistance for Funeral and Other Activities in Case of Death of a Worker’s Scheme is a vital initiative that provides essential support to the families of deceased workers in Haryana.
